services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.text: Suffolk Automotive Care LLC, has always been my go to for annual vehicle state safety inspections! I’ve had 4 of my household vehicles inspected there. Convenient Location, and food services only a walk away. Very professional & friendly staff. Price point for a State Safety Inspection is mote than Great! Scheduling an appointment is super easy. The waiting room is clean and comfy. Highly recommend this place for Vehicle State inspections.

reviews.author: Billy Birdsong
reviews.text: I called Suffolk Automotive Care at the end of the month because my inspection was set to expire the following day. They were able to squeeze me into their schedule and had me back on the road in no time. While I was there I spent some time talking with a few of the employees. It's clear they have a great team that genuinely enjoys what they do and that kind of customer service is hard to find. From this experience, Suffolk Automotive Care has earned my business and they'll be my go to shop for all of my vehicle maintenance and repairs moving forward. Thank you Suffolk Automotive Care!

reviews.author: Mark McCammon
reviews.text: Wonderful service from the call to make an appointment to having the state inspection completed. Warm, friendly staff and the inspector took time to sit down with me to discuss an unrelated repair I had to complete later. I walked in and was told they were running a bit behind, but they should get me out the door by a certain time and delivered. Comfortable chairs in the waiting area invited pleasant conversation Highly HIGHLY recommend this shop and team

reviews.author: Kate Ciaston
reviews.text: Had an appointment for reinspection after an initial failure at another shop. The whole team was very nice and down to earth and got me in and out very quickly. They showed me a part on the car not related to the inspection that was nearly worn through and recommended replacing it. Didn't pressure me to have the repair done through them and I never felt like I had aggressive sales tactics used on me like at the first shop I went to. I will definitely be bringing my other vehicles here for inspection!

reviews.author: Anthony Hann
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Suffolk Automotive Care LLC. I initially failed my car inspection due to my passenger light and license plate light. When I came back for the reinspection, I realized I had accidentally replaced the wrong light. The owner was extremely understanding and helpful, he quickly took care of it for me on the spot. I was in and out of the shop in less than 20 minutes, which I really appreciated. I just recently moved to this area, and after this experience, I can confidently say I’ll be coming back and recommending this shop to others. Great service and great people!

reviews.author: Roger Taylor
reviews.text: Nothing but good things to say about this place. Took my car to get a headlight adjustment. I must say my headlights shining correctly. Thank you for your great service. A+ Customer service.

reviews.author: Angelia Dell
reviews.text: I had an appointment today for a state inspection and had a great experience. The staff was professional, the process was smooth, and the waiting area was comfortable. I was in and out within 30 minutes of my appointment. I’ll definitely be bringing my other vehicles here and keeping them in mind for future car care needs.

reviews.author: Hunter Davis
reviews.text: I don’t leave reviews for anything. If the food was good or the food was bad, I just do or don’t come back… something’s really gotta be different on a whole different kind of level for me to say something about it…. This shop is different David, the owner is in someway involved with everything that’s going on in there… A very hands-on operator. The staff is friendly. The price is reasonable. And the job is quick…… Give my truck back to me in a few hours and for less than I actually expected to pay. I can say with 100% certainty, but if I have another issue with my vehicle, I’m coming here first…. That kind of quality you just don’t come across anymore. Very impressed

reviews.author: Quineisha Woodson
reviews.text: Customer service here was amazing. My motorcycle inspection was done in a timely manner. Everyone was professional and also friendly. I had coffee and a donut while I waited. I would 10/10 recommend!!!

reviews.author: Randy W.
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Suffolk Automotive for a state inspection. I was in and out in just 20 minutes! The team did an excellent job, and the staff was incredibly friendly and professional. Highly recommend them if you're looking for quick and quality service.

reviews.author: Tina Ferguson
reviews.text: This morning on my way to work a vibration began in my front divers side tire followed by a bad noise. It got to the point that I was sure I shouldn’t drive any further and slowed down at which time a driver in the next lane advised me that my tire was wobbly as if it were gonna fall off. I was able to pull into the parking lot of Suffolk Automotive Care and waited until they opened. As soon as they opened they said they would squeeze me into for diagnosis. I was thinking a wheel bearing replacement and headed out to rent a car. They immediately checked out my vehicle and discovered the brake assembly and lug nuts were loose and the tire was indeed about to fall off. They put everything back together as it should be as well as checked the 3 other tires for proper assembly/torque. They not only saved me from having to rent a vehicle but also got me right back into my vehicle with the assurance that it is now safe to drive. They were very responsive and top notch customer service. I will definitely use this shop again if I need any additional automotive service or repairs while working here in the Suffolk area

reviews.author: Derrick C
reviews.text: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! The team here is very professional and upfront (honest), I trust them with my vehicles (x2) automotive needs. I have had scheduled appointments and walk-ins and both options were detailed and timely (appointment recommended though). Again, would highly recommend their services to anyone! 5-stars

reviews.author: Matt Tasker
reviews.text: Awesome place and great people that work here. They keep my car clean and are timely in their work. Prices are fair, at least for the relatively routine things I've had repaired here. They also gave me a free bag of candy over the Christmas holiday when I picked up my car. It's the little things that make a great business and these folks just get it.

reviews.author: Alice Stewart
reviews.text: Great service!! Gave me an appointment for the day I wanted and it was quick to get my car inspected! Courteous employees. Will go back again for any car problems!!

reviews.author: Cherise Darden
reviews.text: Great customer service! The price you get quoted you is what you pay no extra! Fixed my jeep and it’s back running like before! Great all around! So happy my baby is back running right!

reviews.author: Vanessa Nebria
reviews.text: This is the only space where I experienced no stress at all. They honored the appointment time. I thought i needed to go to bed before my car is ready, but was out after 30 minutes. There is also a boba place next to it so you can enjoy great drinks while waiting.

reviews.author: Bryan C
reviews.text: Fast and friendly! Had both of my cars inspected here and will be coming back. Appointment time was ready when I arrived without having to wait, and provided me with maintenance suggestions for upcoming intervals.

reviews.author: April Davis
reviews.text: Awesome experience. They completed my state inspection by appointment. I didn’t wait long and they completed it in great time. I would recommend them for state inspections and your car needs!!

reviews.author: Angelo V
reviews.text: Staff was very nice and helpful. They were able to get my car in for a diagnostic check within the same week too. Their mechanics were very thorough and give you honest next steps.

reviews.author: Caesar King
reviews.text: The service at this establishment was nothing less than excellent. Very respectful staff and kid friendly waiting area. I will most definitely be returning for all of my automotive needs. Thank you all for such a great experience. Continue doing great.

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.text: This establishment was previously my preferred automotive service provider, and I have entrusted all my vehicles to their care for an extended period. Regrettably, I will no longer be utilizing their services. Recently, I brought my vehicle in for a general inspection. I was subsequently informed that suspension work, totaling $1800, was required. While I found this estimate somewhat high, I authorized the repairs due to my prior satisfaction with their service quality and professionalism. My vehicle remained at the facility for several days to facilitate the completion of the work. Upon retrieval, I discovered new damage on the passenger side of the vehicle. The proprietor disavowed any knowledge of the origin of this damage. Consequently, I am now responsible for the cost of repairs for damage that did not exist prior to my vehicle's service at this location. The only explanation provided was a lack of understanding regarding the incident and an inability to offer a resolution. Therefore, I will not be returning to this establishment for future automotive needs.

reviews.author: Heather Van Engen
reviews.text: As just a girl who knows nothing about cars except when the dashboard lights start looking scary, this place was amazing. They explained everything clearly, didn’t make me feel dumb, and fixed my car fast. I left with a working car and significantly less anxiety. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Quinzell Brown
reviews.text: Suffolk Automotive Care were true professionals, the were able to accommodate all three of my cars state inspections in one day. I was extremely impressed with their service.

reviews.author: Jessica Fonseca
reviews.text: I’ve been taking my car here for a while, and I couldn’t be happier with the service. The team is knowledgeable, professional, and always goes the extra mile to make sure my car is in top shape. They explain everything clearly, so I always understand what’s needed and why. I’ve never felt pressured into unnecessary repairs, and they’ve consistently provided quality work that I can trust. Highly recommend to anyone looking for honest, reliable, and efficient car care!

reviews.author: James Lee
reviews.text: Made an appointment for a state inspection and was in and out in 30mins. Exactly what I was looking for since the dealer refuses to make appointments for them and it’s first come first served these days. Thanks for the easy day guys.

reviews.author: The Twisted Lug Nut
reviews.text: I bring all my cars there for inspections and repairs. They’re the most honest and fair shop in Suffolk. They’ve got a lifelong customer here extremely friendly staff.

reviews.author: Leonardo Drummond
reviews.text: Incredible service! They communicated well throughout and gave me multiple options for repairs - including really fair estimates. Honest, knowledgable, and nice people. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Alex Newey
reviews.text: Went to go get my car inspected last week. Was in and out in a flash. Great customer service and experience. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Joshviniel FloresVazquez
reviews.text: Super good team they have, excelente service super friendly and they were patient with my situation when my car was having some issues. Super cool people highly recomended 100%

reviews.author: Edlyne Diaz
reviews.text: Professional, quick and at a reasonable price. Needed my car AC working at top notch. I called and talked to Megan who was very polite and willing to help. She took the time to explain the diagnostic test needed. She then got me schedule for a same day appointment. They were able to get my AC working and also got a state inspection done in less than 3 hours. Great workers, outstanding service. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Derron “ProdiGee” Gee
reviews.text: Just had my vehicle in for inspection and the service is top notch. Very friendly and polite staff. I was in and out in less than 30 minutes, it great to see a shop that respects your time and business. I highly recommended for any of your auto needs.

reviews.author: Sophie Maes
reviews.text: Very fast and friendly service. Comfortable waiting room and knowledgeable staff. Would definitely bring my car here again.

reviews.author: SinVA
reviews.text: So sad that this shop has lost its way since the passing of the original owner, Jeff Chenault. He was an honest man and trusted in the community. I've tried to support the shop but needed to test the waters by going in for my annual inspections before having bigger work done. Both times the mechanic told me I had problems with brakes and suspension and replacement was in the near future. He also threatened to have almost failed my inspection but claimed he was a "nice guy" so he "let me slide". I change my own brakes and suspension, and both were is excellent condition. So, we have a mechanic that up-sells repairs that don't need to be done. And then the owner is standing right there in the conversation condoning the actions of his mechanic. I am fortunate to know better than to be misled by this shop, but feel sorry for those that need a shop they can trust. I don't know where else to recommend in Suffolk so I'll be taking my cars up to the dealer for now.

reviews.author: Calvin Clements
reviews.text: Suffolk Auto Care always been efficient either a wonderful staff!! They’re my go to guys!! Thanks for the service Thursday and today

reviews.author: Star Mechanical Heating and Cooling
reviews.text: I really appreciate this suffolk automotive care I have several different businesses that all use vehicles and they look at each one and give me their honest, opinion and try to help me save money I understand business needs to make money but over there, They really want to make you happy at the end of the day, and give you great experience.. I had the pressure of them installing a new motor for one of my vehicles and I tell you it sounds so good I would not wanna go anywhere else!!!

reviews.author: Katie Schlecker
reviews.text: Highly recommend. I called in a pinch to get my yearly safety inspection done, with a tight schedule, and they quickly accommodated me. They are kind, efficient, courteous, and do a great job. Can't recommend them highly enough!

reviews.author: Michelle Woods
reviews.text: I went here for a State inspection. They still took me as I was late for my appointment. They also aligned my headlights for no extra charge. Very professional and knowledgeable. I'd def go back.

reviews.author: Casey Brown
reviews.text: I’ve been to a lot of shops in the area and I can tell you this is the best one without a doubt. Customer service is top-notch. Quality service and reasonable pricing. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kimberly Lewis
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this company from company from start to finish. Great customer service, friendly, professional staff. They truly went above and beyond to ensure my experience with smoothly!

reviews.author: GoodLife Fitness Florence
reviews.text: This is one of the best places in Suffolk to take care of your automotive needs. I’m a customer for life. Excellent Customer Service!

reviews.author: Rowan Jackson
reviews.text: Great people and great service. I wouldn’t hesitate to bring any of my vehicles back to their establishment.

reviews.author: Alexa King
reviews.text: First time visiting for a state inspection, experience was great! Super friendly, you’re greeted as soon and quick for a state inspection! I appreciate that they Take appointments for state inspections. I recommend this Automotive center

reviews.author: Stephanie Sutherland
reviews.text: Incredible prices & phenomenal customer service. Suffolk Automotive treats you like family. When you walk in you will be greeted with a friendly smile from either Daniel or Megan, who will help ease your mind and ensure your sweet baby (aka car) is in good hands. As a young woman sometimes auto repair shops can feel intimidating, but I had a great experience here. David (the owner) was transparent, respectful, and took the time to explain everything to me. He provided clear upfront pricing and did not try to upsell unnecessary services. Ron & Bobby also deserve special shout outs for their hard work to ensure the cars receive a quick and efficient turn around. Everyone here was sincere and knowledgeable. I will definitely be taking my car back here if any further issues arise. Support this small business because let me tell you…the franchise competitors are often times more expensive and you don’t receive the hospitality like you do here. Additionally they have candy to munch on and a tv to watch while you wait…I mean what could be better? They are like the best kind of car doctor - diagnosed my car’s ‘low energy,’ prescribed fresh batteries, and didn’t try to convince me that I needed a full engine transplant. 10/10 recommend, you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: ashley laclair
reviews.text: I went back around May and I have to say the experience was lovely! They were very quick easy service! Compared to most places they were honestly on top of everything. I highly recommend going there especially if you need a car inspection! Was in and out within like 15 minutes great service!

reviews.author: Kristi
reviews.text: Called up to get my vehicle inspected, if they had any openings that day. And surprisingly they had an opening. Friendly establishment with quality work. I was also notified they do not work on/ repair any Euro vehicles like BMW's/ Mercedes and such. They had comfortable seating in their waiting room and it is child friendly, as well, they had a toy area for your little ones to keep occupied while you wait for your automobile.

reviews.author: Shawn Randall
reviews.text: Came in with a nail in my tire 20 mins before closing. Entire staff friendly and caring. Had us safely out in no time. Wonderful experience. Definitely refer without reservation. Thank you all

reviews.author: kay foltz
reviews.text: This business is wonderful. I needed an inspection but I always took my SUV to Portsmouth but my daughter told me to try this place because she usually go there. I thought what the hell she trust them with her Chevy Camar and that's her baby. What I got to lose. They really did a good job I had an appointment and they took me on time I guess I will not be going back to P Town. Thank you guys so much. They are very professional too

reviews.author: Eagle Brand S
reviews.text: Service was fast and very well performed. The technicians were friendly and very informative, clearly demonstrating their level of experience and expertise. David was the technician who assisted me, and he was exceptionally professional throughout the entire process. I truly appreciated his clear communication and attention to detail. Overall, a great experience!!

reviews.author: Matt Tobolski
reviews.text: I went it due to brakes squealing. They could have lied and charged me for new brakes and rotors. Instead they told me the truth. They will be honest and the work they recommend/charge is for real. super friendly as well. I RECOMMEND 100% i will only use this place from now on.

reviews.author: Marcie XX
reviews.text: This is my second year getting my annual car inspection done at Suffolk Automotive Care. First, I'll start off by saying, this team masters first class quality in both Customer Service and Satisfaction! This team is a well oiled team. They were prompt providing reasonable dates and time and even more, very accommodating. The service they provided made it very easy for my return. Without question, this is a family business that must be supported. They are excellent and courteous. They made me feel valued and that my business is important. This is priceless and thank you very much. Keep up the good work. The community appreciates all you do. Bravo Zulu!

reviews.author: Brian Smith
reviews.text: Fast, friendly & professional! In and out with our inspection in less than 30 minutes! Will be returning!

reviews.author: chace davis
reviews.text: Professional employees both at the front counter and in the shop. Tech went above and beyond to help me with the air conditioning issue and they worked with my schedule.

reviews.author: Krista Schneider
reviews.text: I got a second opinion here for the repairs that another shop recommended and found out that I was about to be way overcharged. Going to Suffolk Automotive Care saved me literally hundreds of dollars and the customer care was wonderful as well. All of the employees that helped me were patient and kind. They made sure that I was able to drive a safe vehicle again without going bankrupt and the repairs were all completed in a timely manner. I would highly recommend this place. Stellar service!

reviews.author: Randy Lane
reviews.text: I needed a tire repair done quickly. I was taken immediately with no appointment on a busy Saturday and was out in around 15-20 minutes. Megan was so friendly and helpful to not only me but all the customers that I saw during my visit. The team is efficient and professional. I highly recommend them and will definitely use them for future auto care needs. The repair was affordable as well.

reviews.author: Laurie Elliott
reviews.text: These people are the best. I went in with what I thought was a break problem and it ended up being so much more. The mechanic was so kind. He brought out pictures and to the time to explain to me what was going on and what was needing to be done. I also over him telling the person doing the bilking, to enter it a certain way because he wanted to keep the labor lower. Nowadays you never hear of anyone doing something in your favor! The car actually drives better than it’s ever driven. I highly recommend these people. Also, my appointment was at 9 o’clock and by 905. They were driving my vehicle in and had it up on the rack. You never go to a car dealership and have that fast of a service

reviews.author: Kelsey Camarata
reviews.text: I've gone here twice now over two different vehicles/issues. I cannot recommend them enough! They are always very honest about what they recommend you do, yet provide zero pressure to get it taken care of right away - just provide a quote and let you think about it if you're not sure. They explain things well and there's never any judgement on me being a girl coming in with a car (as I have had with other mechanics). They are incredibly accommodating for whatever you need. The waiting room is pretty small so keep that in mind. 4-5 chairs with some kids toys which is cool. A side table but no desks, however that hasn't kept me from staying there to work on my laptop. All of the mechanics I have met are incredibly nice. (And knowledgable.) The second time I went, it was a new (used) car inspection and the mechanic even looked up the manufacturer's recommended maintenance up to 150k miles! Suffolk Automotive Care has gone above and beyond every time I've been there. If you're new in town... you won't be disappointed by this place!

reviews.author: Amanda Shaffer
reviews.text: Came here for the first time to get my car inspected and David and Daniel definitely went above and beyond with every little detail, I truly felt like I’d been there before! They were very welcoming and went over every little thing with me in a way I could understand, including pricing! And never made me feel pressured to purchase anything! Will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Cenaa Polk
reviews.text: Everyone I communicated with here was so great. I had never been here before so I called asking for a quote & they got back to me very quickly. Their communication and customer service was amazing. I was kept updated every step of the way. They were also extremely reasonable with pricing. Not to mention, I got my car back very fast. I will be coming back for my future car needs. No complaints.

reviews.author: joshua ramirez
reviews.text: Amazing service! So polite and professional to all the staff members. Provided helpful recommendations to service my car. 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Killian Rush
reviews.text: I went to get my vehicle serviced here and the staff and mechanics were top tier. They explained the problem with my vehicle and found a way for it to be affordable. As well as being honest upfront. I would highly recommend this shop and their mechanics

reviews.author: Casey S
reviews.text: Just got my state inspection done, the staff were all very professional and polite. Being a woman and having my kids have to come with me I felt very comfortable being there. And at no point did they try to push anything I didn’t need to have done. Service was quick too. I was in and out in less than 30 mins!

reviews.author: Erin Mills
reviews.text: Very easy to work with and was very quick to get my inspection done. Very polite and friendly when explaining what work would be beneficial for the car! :)

reviews.author: Jason Green
reviews.text: Everyone was extremely nice and very professional. The finished my car quickly and everything was perfect. Will recommend!

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text: My inspection sticker was damaged when the windshield was replaced a glass company. I stopped by since I get my inspections done here and the friendly folks hooked me up on the spot with a new inspection and at no cost. Thank you!

reviews.author: The White Family
reviews.text: I took my wife’s Kia Sportage here for a state inspection. I was told I had a nail in my tire and my breaks needed to be replaced soon. I was getting low tire pressure on that tire before I took the car in, so I knew that to be true. I was told a week prior while getting an oil change my breaks needed to be changed soon, so I knew that to be true. This shop is honest, has fair prices, and fast work. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: GiGi
reviews.text: I had scheduled an inspection on a Saturday morning, I mistakenly showed up an hour early. Not only were they extremely friendly but squeezed me in early. Being a woman it’s hard to trust a lot of places, but they are so honest and friendly. Definitely my go to place for now on!

reviews.author: Hakeem Turner
reviews.text: Quick, professional, and hassle-free! Came in for an oil change, and the team at Suffolk Automotive Care had me in and out in no time. They were friendly, efficient, and didn’t try to upsell unnecessary services. Pricing was fair, and they took great care of my car. Definitely my go-to spot for maintenance!

reviews.author: tonixriLey
reviews.text: I Had another shop fail my inspection and quote me 2800$ for things I didn’t need. The employees at Suffolk Automotive care all extremely friendly and had my inspection done in a very timely manner. Highly recommend this business to anyone looking for an inspection or any other work done on their vehicle.

reviews.author: Matt Brown
reviews.text: This is a bit of a different review as this business did not actually service my car. This is more about their professionalism and courtesy. I had my car towed there after it stopped working. In short order, they ran a diagnostic. Instead of quoting a price to repair, they knew their trade and did the right thing for their customer. The researched the make and model and found a technical service bulletin that applied to what was happening. Again… INSTEAD OF JUST CHARGING ME AND MAKING MONEY… they called me up, explained the issue and recommended I have it towed to a local dealer for potential warranty repair even thought the factory warranty was expired. Everything they said was correct and the part would have been covered for free. It’s rare to find this kind of integrity in an auto move shop these days and I will recommend them to everyone I can.

reviews.author: kenny corle
reviews.text: I have been coming here for 3 years and the service is always quick and the workers are friendly. 5stars!

reviews.author: Carley Roberson
reviews.text: Such a great place to get your inspection! I was in and out and everyone was very friendly. If anything is to happen to my car and it needs to go to the shop I would definitely bring it back here!

reviews.author: Shanice Arevalo
reviews.text: If you’re looking for exceptional service, this is the auto shop to visit! I went in at 9:00 AM for a state inspection & tire rotation. They found that a rear light that was out & fixed it. By 9:30 AM, I was back on the road! The staff was efficient, professional, and friendly. The pricing was very reasonable too. Highly recommend this place for quick and quality service!

reviews.author: Justin Stark
reviews.text: This place was awesome, customer service was beyond exceptional. Had a 330 appt for an inspection, got there a little early, keys in hand barely 15 min later tires inflated, the whole 9 yards. Excellent spot, wished I'd known about them sooner.

reviews.author: Karen Wills
reviews.text: My car had battery issues and my friend recommended SUFFOLK AUTOMOTIVE took my car up there yesterday and these were the nicest group of people. They were kind and caring took a look at my car and it turned out to be a quick fix and they didn't even charge me . These people are very kind honest and trustworthy. I will definitely be using them for anything in the future. A great team. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Walker Koldplay
reviews.text: Had three amazing service experiences in the last 10 months. Fair prices, quality service, and nothing that isn't needed. In fact, I sat in the lobby to hear a representative tell a customer that nothing was needed for her car and no charges were incurred! Rare honesty and amazing to witness. Suffolk Automotive has earned my continued future business!

reviews.author: Angela B
reviews.text: I was wowed by this auto shop! Daniel who answers the phones is extremely professional, polite and courteous! He was able to get me in the same afternoon that I had called. Their prices were very reasonable, the shop was quick, and they also kept me informed of progress throughout the short time they had my car. They were forthcoming/honest in informing me what work absolutely needed done and what did not. I will definitely be coming back for further work and due to my excellent experience - would highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Alexandra O'Dea
reviews.text: The team that helped service my Tacoma today was super nice and helpful. A lot of shops can feel scammy but they seemed really honest, got my truck sorted, and offered a free warranty on their repairs.

reviews.author: Christian McClung
reviews.text: Amazing! From the moment you walk in the door to the moment you leave with your keys. These guys are true professionals at what they do. From State Inspections to routine maintenance and more. Daniel at the front has amazing customer service and the techs are knowledgeable in what they do. Did I mention the pricing is fair! I send the women in my life to this shop because they are trustworthy! Hard to find these days. I highly recommend Suffolk Auto Care Services!

reviews.author: Charles Fisher
reviews.text: Great customer service, even though they could not diagnose or replicate the problem. They still gave me a quote on something that turned out not to be the problem. After taking my car elsewhere, I found out it was not what they were trying to quote me for. Still, great customer service though

reviews.author: Myles Weider
reviews.text: Very nice group of people. It was my first time there and I came in for my vehicle inspection half an hour early. The guy doing the inspection (I'm terrible with names sorry) saw to it anyway despite it taking out time from his lunch break. I was fine with waiting but I really appreciate it nonetheless. Everyone else was very nice and helpful too.

reviews.author: Aireal Crowley
reviews.text: Daniel and staff at Suffolk automotive are very professional and give great service, thanks to their fast work and experience my truck was fixed within 24 hour's after it was brought to their shop for a serious issue. No job was to big for these folks to help in my time of urgency and I am very grateful for their professionalism and great job to keep my babies and I safe. Would recommend this shop for anyone who appreciates professionalism and great service. Thank you Suffolk Automotive team!!!

reviews.author: Benjamin Dick
reviews.text: I had my 3 cars up there to get in inspection and it’s was done fast I did do appointment for the other two car but I was there at 7:30 there didn’t open till 8:00 first car was home by 8:15 so go check them out . They can handle it

reviews.author: Jasmine Williams
reviews.text: I needed my car inspected today and my brother called ahead and found this place for me. When I called, Dave was expecting me and booked the appointment. Service was fast and staff is very friendly! They even put my new license plates on for me. I will be back for all my needs. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Lizzy Cotton
reviews.text: I came in there today with a loose Radiator hose and they were able to fix it really quick. My truck did have an issue the first time he tried to fix it but he was able to go back in and redo it. They were super nice and honestly really affordable. I thought it was going to cost a lot to fix the issue but it was only 60$ for it which was really surprising. And he didn’t mention the fact that my dashboard lights up like a Christmas tree. He also put more washer fluid in my truck which I really appreciate. I highly recommend going here if you have an issue with your vehicle

reviews.author: Danielle Lindquist
reviews.text: I finally took my car in to get my brakes looked at, since they've been squalling for a while. I was greeted by Debbie and Megan who were very welcoming, and David had an estimate for me within the hour. They were very honest and upfront with what was going on, and the cost for the repair which I really appreciated. They were able to complete the repair that same day, and my car is now in a much better state! I really appreciated the care and communication this shop provides, and I would be happy to recommend them to anyone. Suffolk Automotive Care and the people that work there have a passion for not only what they do, but the community they serve. Huge thank you to David, Debbie and Megan for all that you do!

reviews.author: Christian Darling
reviews.text: I was having issues finding a reputable place to get my car inspected, due to a lot of shops being backed up for days on end. I was recommended to go try Suffolk Automotive out and the work they handle here is amazing. On time as well as quick, fast and reliable. The personnel working there are all kind and quick to assist you if need be. Will be returning in the future!

reviews.author: Frankie Fisher
reviews.text: I never knew I would have so much trouble getting air in my tires the day before the snow arrived. When my tire pressure light came on, I tried three different establishments, but the air compressers were out of commission. After the snow, I went to Suffolk Automotive where their customer service was awesome. My tires were serviced and the owner made sure my vehicle was safe. I will definitely be returning to Suffolk Automotive as deemed necessary.

reviews.author: Erin Moore
reviews.text: Dave has been great with all the vehicles we have taken to him! He and his mechanics are friendly and it is nice to be able to speak directly with them rather than going back and forth with a middle person. They are honest and will tell you directly if they are able to fix an issue or not. They have no issues referring you to another reputable mechanic if they are not able to fix what needs to be done and that is much appreciated! Thank you!

reviews.author: Pat Mitchell
reviews.text: The employees are always very pleasant and they move quickly to get my inspection completed. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Skyla
reviews.text: I drive by this shop & decided to try it on a whim with my fingers crossed because I had to take a road trip and my tire seemed to be slowly leaking.. I’m glad I did because they were very polite and had good customer service and were really quick (which I definitely needed). 5 stars! Thanks for great service

reviews.author: Angie Pope
reviews.text: Wonderful shop, wonderful staff! Megan got me scheduled so quickly for a state inspection, and then for necessary repairs. The owner, David, is extremely kind and accommodating, and the whole teams workmanship is phenomenal. My car has absolutely never run better. Thank you for everything, Suffolk Automotive and team! Highly recommend bringing your car here for any needs you may have!

reviews.author: Tamara Bailey-Gatling
reviews.text: AMAZING!!! Quick fast and in a hurry! They were awesome. Same day appointment to get a state inspection. This is not a first come first serve basis for state inspections like other places...you can actually get an appointment. The people working here are super nice and very friendly. Normally this is not an enjoyable process but this was a super great experience. Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: April Bodden
reviews.text: Set up an inspection and oil change for a Saturday 9am. They are very pleasant to speak with and have great service. They took my car right away and updated me on the results of my inspection while they were finishing up my oil change. The entire process took and hour. I recommend setting up an appointment because they fill up with walk ins but definitely stick to their appointment times. I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: Daryl Cyrus
reviews.text: Wow! What a welcome relief that I've found my "Go-to Auto Shop", and I no longer have to worry about where to take my vehicles for maintenance and repair. For the past 2 years I've taken my vehicles there and recommended others, and we've experienced nothing but excellent customer service and quality workmanship. Most recently, I had an issue with leaking engine coolant (not something you want to play with). I took to David and received my car back. However, I noticed several weeks later that the issue had returned. I took it back with full intention that this issue this would be a new repair order with a new repair estimate - however, I was pleased to learn that David considered this a warrantied item and he was not going to charge for reassessing the issue and repairing it. He personally made sure my engine was pressure tested, and road tested to ensure the issue was resolved. This meant a lot because that showed me this business Values INTEGRITY (Doing Right by People) over Profit. When you call or come in you'll get used to talking with Megan or Daniel and will Always be greeted with compassion and care. You'll also see David (The Owner) who makes it a point to Thank You for your business and who actively Listens to your concerns. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND Suffolk Automotive Care.

reviews.author: Alan Frank
reviews.text: This place was great! Dave was quick with his work and communicated everything with me. Everyone there was cool and easy-going.

reviews.author: Mercedes Mann63
reviews.text: Great customer service and really quick turnaround time for state inspection with an appointment. I arrived early and was able to get my car inspected a little earlier. The waiting area was really clean and comfortable. The receptionist was nice and very polite. I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.author: Courtney Gaines
reviews.text: S/o to Suffolk Automotive Service for helping me pass my inspection and doing my brakes! I was in and out in less than an hour! The customer service was amazing! They’re friendly honest and affordable! Not to mention they have the CUTEST babygirl keeping the place in tip top shape lol! They definitely gained a customer today!

reviews.author: Sunshinevp
reviews.text: I just had the very best service ever here at Suffolk Automotive Service. I drove to Suffolk from Central Texas for a brief stay and I had a check engine light come on. The Suffolk Automotive team really took care of me. They went above and beyond to make sure I get back home safely. I highly recommend Suffolk Automotive for your car care needs. Thank you, everyone! I truly appreciate the acts of kindness you extended to me during this visit! Vanessa

reviews.author: danielle loya
reviews.text: They were amazing, the staff was great and kind. The amount the quoted me over the phone was exactly what I paid. They have a vending machine with snacks and they even sell marmalade. I thought that was a lovely feature. They replaced my radiator in a couple of hours, I was in and out the same day as they said I would be. They even fixed a couple of very minor things they noticed while they had my car like a button being out of place, with no additional charge. It was a great experience. I was comfortable there, I trusted them, they kept their word about everything, and I will definitely be going there for all of my cars needs.

reviews.author: Carla T
reviews.text: Suffolk Automotive was great. We called at the last minute prior to working out of town for an extended time.They were able to get us in quickly. The gave us an 11:30 appointment. They came to service the vehicle on time. The service here and their reputation is impeccable. If you need your Virginia inspection done, I recommend you tgoing to Suffolk Automotive. I will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Why the Curiosity
reviews.text: I've been to numerous automotive repair shops over the years, but none compare to the outstanding service I received at Suffolk Automotive. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a warm welcome and an assurance that my car was in the best hands. The team at Suffolk Automotive is incredibly knowledgeable and skilled. They took the time to thoroughly explain the issues with my vehicle and provided a clear, detailed estimate before beginning any work. This level of transparency is something I've rarely experienced elsewhere. What truly impressed me was their ability to source a part that Safelite couldn't find. I had been struggling to get my car fixed for weeks, but Suffolk Automotive stepped up and got the job done swiftly and efficiently. Their resourcefulness and dedication to solving my problem were remarkable. Not only did they fix the issue efficiently, but they also went above and beyond by checking other potential problems and offering valuable maintenance tips to keep my car running smoothly. Their attention to detail and commitment to excellence is truly commendable. What sets Suffolk Automotive apart is their exceptional customer service. They made me feel like a valued customer, not just another job to complete. Their friendly and professional approach made the entire experience stress-free and enjoyable. I am thrilled with the results and can confidently say that Suffolk Automotive has earned my trust and loyalty. From now on, they will be the only place I take my car for any repairs or maintenance. Thank you, Suffolk Automotive, for your unparalleled service and dedication to your customers!

reviews.author: Francheska Curtis
reviews.text: I usually handle all my car needs at a local mechanic because in my experience they care more & are actually skilled to do the job at hand compared to service shops at dealerships. Back in June my friend convinced me to take my car (2021 Nissan Sentra) back to the Nissan dealership so they can figure out the issue with my car as it had failed to start a couple of times even after some jumpstarts. Long story short Nissan ran a diagnostic test & said they didn’t find anything wrong with the battery, it’s a good battery but was low on charge so they charged it to full capacity and said I shouldn’t have any issues moving forward. Didn’t make any sense to me at the time but I decided to roll with it still and trust their expertise. Fast forward it’s Sept 9/16 to be exact and my car did not want to start. After getting a jump, I drove straight to Suffolk Automotive instead of going back to Nissan & I’m so glad I did. They were able to find and resolve the issue within 2 hours. Turns out I needed a new battery after all, the previous one was not able to hold a charge at the recommended voltage. Needless to say, I will be going to Suffolk Automotive for my future car needs!

reviews.author: Travis Blackwell
reviews.text: Awesome service! Fast turn around after diagnosis, and very fair price. I would recommend them to anyone and would not hesitate to use them again!

reviews.author: Linda Lewter
reviews.text: This shop went above and beyond. I loved their flexibility and professionalism. They are my go to for my car repair needs, especially being a female that no nothing about cars.

reviews.author: Annette White
reviews.text: I had been trying to get my car inspected and every where I called told me it will be at least a week before they could get me in ,I called Suffolk Automotive Yesterday and they got me in today . When I got there they were packed and I left my vehicle expecting to have to leave it until Friday, it was 3:30 and they close at 5. However the receptionist, who was very friendly and professional called and said they were staying over to get to my vehicle and they did. the mechanic who inspected the vehicle apologized for having to go beyond 5, it was 5:30 when i picked up the vehicle. I want to give them a hundred stars! they are great,

reviews.author: Troy Dildy
reviews.text: Wow!!! Such a wonderful experience. Coming in I was stressed out about 3 studs and nuts on my tire breaking off. I went to the actual dealership to get the work done that the car was purchased from, and they literally turned me away. Then, out of a whelm, I was led here. First and foremost, Daniel was so welcoming and calm. His demeanor elevated the prior stress that I had. He was very attentive to my issues/concerns. After ending my rant, he calmly checks with the mechanic and returns to say "we can help you out" with options! While relieved, I listen to the options that they provided and made my decision. While doing so, the mechanic actually comes from the back and informs me of the difference of the options. And man, this guy is so calm and confident. Having said that, I was very confident that he would get the job done. Then, the mechanic says, "I'll get started on it right now!" I was literally in shock. Never had a mechanic tell me something, and actually do what he said at that vsry moment. Not even a hour and a half later, the job was complete. I cannot reiterate enough how great the atmosphere here is and the professionalism blew me away. Not realizing that Daniel and David (the mechanic) are brothers. This explains the calmsness and confidence they both displayed. This is truly a great place, a great family atmosphere. The prices they charge are great as well. Will get my vehicles serviced here from now on, instead of getting the run-a-rounds at the actual dealership. Didn't get a chance to get the other mechanics names, but you will definitely see that they're all family here. GREAT SERVICE!!!! GREAT PEOPLE!!!!

reviews.author: Rodger Witchey
reviews.text: I got to meet 3 of the most interesting people. The Receptionist Debbie was just an absolute joy. After speaking to Debbie for just a few minutes, I knew I would enjoy returning to the shop for years to come. A gentleman, a customer, sorry but I forgot his name, was also someone I felt a certain kinship with and will remember him should I ever see him again. He was a salt of the Earth type person and we spoke of by-gone times that we both missed. Finally, the Mechanic/Owner, (I am really bad with names bit I think it was Mark or Mike) he inspected my vehicle, it passed, and he had a small list of things he thought I should be aware of but they were not critical items so, I could put them off if I wanted. He did, however, give me an estimate which at first, I thought was high but after thinking on it a bit it really was reasonable. I only thought it was high because I usually do all the work on my cars, and I didn't think it would take very long to do the work. I am getting older though, and it would take me forever. I have been looking for a mechanic I can TRUST, and I think I may have found that person. Trust does not come easy for me so; this says a lot. I hope everyone will try this small business and give a good referral online. I will return team Suffolk Automotive.

reviews.author: Steven Safari
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience. I was in town for the weekend, and popped into without an appointment. They were able to get me in for an inspection without any issue. The care team, Daniel and Debbie were also AMAZING. Thank you for your service to the greater Suffolk area and beyond! - Steve

reviews.author: Lily Hamann
reviews.text: Nightmare Experience My hope is that, as a business, this is an opportunity to utilize best practices and implement better business procedures, but also that no one will have to endure what my family has had to with Suffolk Automotive Care. My car has been in and out of their shop 3 times in 7.5 weeks. Each time it has been returned to me, (reportedly repaired) the first time it was driven, it has left me stranded requiring a tow. They reported faulty repair parts, certain technicians on vacation, and parts still on-order as the reasons for its back-to-back breakdowns and exorbitantly extended repair timelines. They had given hope for a quick turn-a-round, but have lacked communicating updates. (This statement is an overall statement. Megan was very good in the first 3 weeks calling me with updates, however, as time went on the communication exponentially decreased). I had to continuously contact the shop when I hadn’t heard any news on the repair, only to be informed it wasn't ready for one reason or another. No effort had been given to expedite the repairs or make this top priority despite the terrible cascade of unfortunate events happening within their business. They have in no way provided even the most basic customer service amid repeated business failures. To say this was an inconvenience for my family would be a gross understatement. Additionally, it has been an incredible financial burden and huge loss of confidence in local small business. I will not be a return customer nor will I recommend this business.

reviews.author: Derick Harris
reviews.text: They were great. Had an appointment at 2pm for state inspection. The person at the counter was friendly and she checked us in and took our keys. We told them we had somewhere to be so we would be back after dropping the keys off. They called us as we came back saying it was done about an hour later. Cheap, quick and friendly. We will be back again next year.

reviews.author: Gena Bines
reviews.text: The staff is wonderful here. I had my inspection done without a hitch. "Passed" David is knowledgeable and informed me about my inspection. Also I'm a Registered Nurse and strict about infection control. Megan disinfected all of the pens to be use and that had been used by customers. 5 stars is just not enough.

reviews.author: Kathryn Elliott
reviews.text: Super great service. Very friendly atmosphere. I was in and out very quick. I definitely will be back. I highly recommend this company. Best customer service I’ve had in a long time with a vehicle.

reviews.author: Paloma Gutierrez
reviews.text: Started hearing a loud noise in my car and was nervous to take it in to get checked. I took my car in Suffolk Automotive and my car was looked at and fixed in the same day! I received a call with a detailed explanation of what was wrong and recommendations moving forward. Everyone was friendly and professional and I was able to leave confident that I was in good hands! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ann Britt
reviews.text: I found a screw in my tire and immediately went to Suffolk Automotive Care because of the kindness they had showed me a few years ago. Again, they solved my problem right away, and had me rolling down the road! The friendly staff put me at ease, and dropped everything to help. I highly recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Iliana Rodriguez
reviews.text: I was looking to have my car inspected. Called a few shops but everyone I spoke to was a bit short and rude. I am glad I found this shop. The vibe in here is very chill and the staff is very friendly and hysterical! Thank you David for inspecting my vehicle and for rotating the tires. And a special thank you to Megan. What a freaking sweetheart! I will recommend your shop to ANYONE who wants great service and great prices. God bless you guys. Until next time. Once again, Thank YOU!

reviews.author: Lisa Cover
reviews.text: I went to Suffolk Automotive Care for a vehicle inspection. It was easy to get an appointment and Megan was very friendly and helpful. My car failed the inspection but they were able to get the parts I needed and David fixed everything and got me back on the road - the same day! I'm glad I found this shop! Service was great and prices were affordable - yay!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Pamela Carroll
reviews.text: I brought my Nissan Altima in for an inspection and was so pleased by the prices and the great attitude the entire staff had .I was in and out in no time..and the prices were perfect for my lonely pocket..I highly recommend Suffolk automotive for all your needs with your car . they do inspections and auto repair.. once again I highly recommend this company..you won't be sorry..I know I left with a big smile on my face and my pocket was happy too .

reviews.author: John Simmonds
reviews.text: The folks at Suffolk Auto Care took care of me when others wouldn't. These folks were fast, courteous, respectful and professional. Would 10/10 come back! These folks are top knotch!

reviews.author: Keri Bagley
reviews.text: Steer clear of this place! We visited several times for the same brake issue. I returned in hopes that the issues would be fixed for free. We were able to warranty out the parts, but still had to pay the labor. Then, the same issue occurred about two months later. I then found out that the part I'd brought in to be replaced on the passenger side had been put on the driver side. The owner then mansplained how brakes and calipers work. Ended up having to take it elsewhere to have the work that I paid for actually done. The people up front are very nice and professional. Unfortunately, the owner is condescending and unhelpful.

reviews.author: Matt Contreras
reviews.text: Went in for a state inspection. Was able to beat the rush and was in and out in no time. David was very kind and professional. Recommended what I should keep an eye on for replacing which is awesome. Would be comfortable taking my car here for repairs, but they will also let you know what you should do if you have the confidence to diy. They also gave me a jar of orange marmalade. Very kind and honest shop.

reviews.author: Cameron Lancaster
reviews.text: Oil change and they took care of my front brakes and rotors. Just honest! Really and in the automotive business being true to your word with no hidden costs is a breath of fresh air. Good people and knowledgeable. Thank you Suffolk Automotive Care team! My mazda CX5 also thanks you

reviews.author: Juanita Kendall
reviews.text: Suffolk Auto employees r a great crew. Service is in & out in a timely manner. Prices r in range w/ even doing the work yourself. So, I give them a plus. My brother used to do my work & I did too, but as we grow , I don't get under the hood much & my brother retired & chose not to work on vehicles anymore.

reviews.author: Claire Molinaro
reviews.text: We stopped in here when an indicator light came on at the start of a family trip. David was able to help us immediately even though we were a walk in and the shop was fairly busy. He and his team provided good service, quickly, and they were all very friendly. They even gave us homemade marmalade as a holiday gift!

reviews.author: Quantia Riddick
reviews.text: I went here to get my car inspected on yesterday and the employees were so polite and helpful even gave me great feedback on a few things . The lady that works at the front desk even gave my kids toys to play with while we wait for our vehicle . I highly recommend going here for your services . I definitely will be returning

reviews.author: steve perfetti
reviews.text: I will recommend this place to anyone needing work on their vehicle!! I came in on a recommendation and they took me right in and offered me lunch. They were super polite and was in and out in a very short amount of time. Thank you for the great service!!!

reviews.author: Al Bustamante
reviews.text: Great family-owned business. Needed a vehicle inspection and they were able to get me in and take care of my truck with no hassle. Customer service was friendly and courteous. Thank you for the quick and efficient service!

reviews.author: Gabrielle Earhardt
reviews.text: We were able to get seen within hours of calling for an appointment. Getting the truck registered only took about 15-30 minutes! Staff are completely friendly and helpful. You can tell they take pride in there work. Definitely would be coming back!

reviews.author: David VanDyke
reviews.text: Excellent service with friendly employees. I've been there twice now. Each time was completely painless. They got my cars in very quickly. Very honest.

reviews.author: Gloria Spencer
reviews.text: Received an inspection today. There was no wait because I made an appointment earlier. The staff were friendly and polite. Good place to go.

reviews.author: Amari C
reviews.text: I went in for a tire repair and from the moment I opened the door, the customer service was very welcoming! They were able to patch the hole in my tire within the hour and at a reasonable price. I know where to go the next time I need my car serviced!

reviews.author: EnvyRaf
reviews.text: I’m 19 and i’ve been coming to this shop since i got my first car. customer service is exceptional and so is the quality of work. i’ve got too many stories of times i thought id need a new car and they got it back to me running amazing for a good price in comparison to other shops and dealers in the area. 10/10 recommend

reviews.author: Shemeka Lewis
reviews.text: Customer service was great walked in when the shop first open needed brakes and front rotor almost went sliding in the building but the did a great job. The wait was not even long at all. I was still able to enjoy my morning.

reviews.author: Valerie Wilson
reviews.text: I needed to get my mom’s van in to get it inspected. I live in Suffolk and I have my mom’s van from HAMPTON so I needed to get it done right away. They got me in the same day. I was so grateful. they save me a lot of headache. I really appreciate their courtesy of getting me in soon.

reviews.author: Charles chance
reviews.text: The first honest auto repair shop I have found in Suffolk. They do a great job and pay attention to detail. This is the second time I have been there and like the first time I am pleasantly surprised. Thanks so much I highly recommend you and I will be back.

reviews.author: Loren Hubbard
reviews.text: David and his team were extremely helpful and professional! I had a great experience with my service and will definitely be coming back! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Cait
reviews.text: In and out with 2 state inspections very quickly. Customer service was very pleasant. Would def return and recommend this place!!

reviews.author: hedwig pichel
reviews.text: Excellent costumer service, honest and fair quotes, highly recommend getting your car serviced at Suffolk automotive care. Peace of mind knowing that you’re being treated fairly and are well taken care of!

reviews.author: Jesse Gray
reviews.text: Went in for a state inspection and the process was quick and efficient. They didn’t try to sell me on a bunch of things I didn’t need, which is always nice. Also, the customer service was great! Thank you!

reviews.author: Dark Cloud Productions
reviews.text: The very best customer service in Suffolk. If you need a mechanic and your are in the downtown Suffolk area, these are the people you should give an opportunity to earn your business.

reviews.author: Maverick Navarrette
reviews.text: Had a quick and easy experience . Just got my new mustang inspected by the nice folks here . Went in thinking I might not get an inspection but came out surprised and happy !

reviews.author: Kevin Krueger
reviews.text: My Envoy broke down during my road trip right before 4th July weekend, Friday night. The alternator failed. I towed it to the only repair shop open on a Saturday. My car was ready before check-out!! They are the nicest folks to deal with…. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Letitia Jackson
reviews.text: I took my truck in for a state inspection and it was quick and easy. Customer service was awesome! All the guys were very professional.

reviews.author: Rick Maine
reviews.text: The friendly and knowledgeable staff were able to get me a last minute appointment and got me in and out when several other local shops wouldn't even look at my car. Cannot recommend these guys enough. Exemplary service!

reviews.author: Michael Vain
reviews.text: Great staff who know how to treat others like people. Very friendly & professional, this shop works for their money, keeping prices reasonable while delivering timely and quality service. Highly recommend to anyone in the area for repairs both minor and major.

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.text: I came in for an inspection and was done in less than 30 minutes! Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful! Will definitely come back for future car maintenance!

reviews.author: Anne marie Williams
reviews.text: Fantastic customer service, honest, quick and great with communication. I have gone to them a number of times and every time has been exceptional. I definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Austin Sergeant
reviews.text: The staff here at Suffolk Automotive treat you just like family! My inspection was super quick and even went out of their way to replace a kissing valve stem cover!

reviews.author: Kimberly Hester
reviews.text: I took my vehicle for the first time to get it inspected and was very impressed with the friendly and professional staff. Ron did a great job and I will be taking my vehicle back again!

reviews.author: Carine ROCHARD
reviews.text: Afraid by a very low rate of oil indicated in our rental car, we stopped there and had a very welcome service, with a large smile and a fast check. The check was ok and we had been able to look forward our next destination. We hardly recommande and thanks a lot. Regards.

reviews.author: roxanna diaz
reviews.text: The service was great! They were able to see me the same day and I was in and out within an hour. Very friendly staff and mechanic team.

reviews.author: Nicole B
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Got my state inspection and oil change done so fast! The staff were honest, sweet and personable!!

reviews.author: Trevon Randle
reviews.text: Came in with an appointment for a state inspection and was done in no time. They were super helpful and professional found my new spot to come to!!

reviews.author: Ashley Levine
reviews.text: Beware of this place. I brought my car in for a state inspection. I was told that my brakes were barely passable. So I purchased pads and rotors, jacked up my car, and took everything apart. Front pads had 50% life left and back pads had 75% life left, rotor wear was even and in spec according to a Haynes manual.

reviews.author: Gina Seward
reviews.text: We have all our vehicles serviced here and from the moment you walk through the door you feel like family!! They do an outstanding job and do not rob you blind! I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tracey Poley
reviews.text: David was awesome! Got me in and out with my inspection and even provided me with tail light bulbs to ensure I passed my inspection! Very nice and friendly staff! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: antonyo Harris
reviews.text: Excellence, service, great customer service. They were able to squeeze me in for a state inspection, and of course passed!

reviews.author: Kendall Fennell
reviews.text: Suffolk Automotive worked on my Chevy Equinox that would not start and everybody was so nice and all the technicians were quick and professional and kept me updated the whole process I will return for any other services.

reviews.author: Justin Kersey
reviews.text: Went here for a state inspection. They got me in and out. Customer service was amazing. Would definitely recommend them over other shops. It has a vary old fashion mom and pop feel. Will be going here more often.

reviews.author: Nick Collins
reviews.text: Great customer service. Showed up early to my inspection appointment time and they were ready to take the car in. Was done by the time I was supposed to show up

reviews.author: Jackie Snyder
reviews.text: Megan and the entire staff made my visit fast and easy when getting my car inspected a few weeks ago. Even went home with a yummy jar of homemade marmalade! Recommend highly.

reviews.author: Rodeshia Anderson
reviews.text: Thanks for your service. This was my 1st time visiting your establishment. We were in and out quickly. Everyone in the facility was welcoming and your price are very reasonable. Thanks again we will definitely be back in the future.

reviews.author: Lee Gaines
reviews.text: The entire staff Suffolk Automotive genuinely care about you and your vehicle. They are the best car services in Suffolk maybe in the Hampton Roads area!

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text: This shop has good honest techs (David) and Daniel at the counter provides great customer service. If you need an inspection they have convenient scheduling and in 30 minutes you're on your way.

reviews.author: Linda Y
reviews.text: Suffolk Automotive did a great job on my car. They were significantly less than the Dealer and Jeff, the Owner, gives excellent customer service. I will definitely be back!!!

reviews.author: Sarah Morris
reviews.text: I came here for a state inspection after being turned away at so many places because they all wanted me to leave my car for the day. The staff here were really friendly and had no problem with me waiting with my kids. He gentleman at the counter even turned on pbs on the tv for my son. I was in and out really fast. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Amy Hobbs
reviews.text: David and Daniel were kind and patient and very informative. I will definitely be going back! Y’all go check them out!

reviews.author: Randy Bliefernich
reviews.text: These guys do excellent work and are professional and fast! David did a great job with my wifes car and we could not be happier with the service.

reviews.author: Tree Universe
reviews.text: Great place to get inspections and car fixed . David is a great help , and I appreciate the help he gave me . 10/10 highly recommend if you getting anything done to your car

reviews.author: Raynard Shears
reviews.text: Excellent customer service Needed a state inspection and they worked with me to get one done the same day I called. Service was fast and professional!

reviews.author: Trent Marshall
reviews.text: David was super helpful and efficient for my needs. The team at Suffolk Auto Care are truly cut above the rest.

reviews.author: Janice Branch
reviews.text: So happy to have customer-friendly, experienced people to take care of my automobile. They tell you what the problem (s) is/are, they complete the work in a timely fashion and I have always been pleased with their service. I don t want more problems; however I look forward to going there.
